title: Today's Words (מילות היום)
text: Are you willing to help me organize the party tomorrow? The ticket costs a lot, but the exhibition is worth seeing. Old cars often break down on long trips. I can't stand loud music in the morning. Please carry on with your work.

glossary.contextNote: be worth + ing: worth seeing, worth trying.
